original: teṣāṃ tu varṣāṇi (vedamuktidaṃ ? śvetamunnataṃ), lohitaṃ veṇumaṇḍalakaṃ, jīmūtaṃ svairathākāraṃ, haritaṃ lavaṇaṃ, kakuddhṛtimad, mānasaṃ pravarakaṃ, kapilaṃ kākusmamiti vibhūtimanti sapta | saptaiva ca si(ddhovo ? ndhavaḥ) dhūtapāpā yonitoyā, śivā, pavitrā, vi(tṛ)ṣṇā ca, candrā hlādinī, vidyuccandrakā, vibhāvarī (daṇḍāvṛ ? puṇḍrā dhṛ)tirmahatīti |
analyzed: teṣām tu varṣāṇi vedamukti dam śvetam unnatam lohitam veṇumaṇḍalakam jīmūtam svairathākāram haritam lavaṇam kakuddhṛtimat mānasam pravarakam kapilam kākusmam iti vibhūtimanti sapta sapta eva ca dhūtapāpā yonitoyā śivā pavitrā vitṛṣṇā ca candrā hlādinī vidyuccandrakā vibhāvarī daṇḍāvṛ puṇḍrā dhṛtiḥ mahatī iti

original: krauñcadvīpe kro(ñceṇa ? ñco) vāmano′ndhakāro devā(vṛ)tirde(vendro ? vano) govindaḥ puṇḍarīka iti sapta varṣaparvatāḥ | dvividaḥ pāvaka iti govindavāmanāvāhuḥ | saptaiva ca varṣāṇi kuśalo manonuga uṣṇaḥ pāva(ra ? na)ko′ndha(kā)rako munideśo dundubhisvara iti | (dvā ? tā)vatya eva nadyaḥ |
analyzed: krauñcadvīpe kroñceṇa ñcaḥ vāmana undhakāraḥ devāvṛtiḥ devendraḥ vanaḥ govindaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ iti sapta varṣaparvatāḥ dvividaḥ pāvakaḥ iti govinda vāmanau āhuḥ sapta eva ca varṣāṇi kuśalaḥ manonugaḥ uṣṇaḥ pāvara naka undhakārakaḥ munideśaḥ dundubhisvaraḥ iti dvā tāvatyaḥ eva nadyaḥ

original: gaurī kumudvatī sandhyā rātriḥ khyātiḥ puṇḍarīkā manojaveti gaṅgābhedāḥ |
analyzed: gaurī kumudvatī sandhyā rātriḥ khyātiḥ puṇḍarīkā manojavā iti gaṅgā bhedāḥ

analyzed: śalmali dvīpe tu suramanāḥ iti parimaṇḍalāḥ trayaḥ varṣaparvatāḥ varṣāṇi kuśalāḥ pāparakam andhakārakam iti trīṇi eva

original: gomedadvīpe surakumudāvañjanaśātakumbha(yoḥ ? mayau) pūrvapaścimo varṣaparvataḥ(?) | varṣe ca dve | varṣaparvataparimaṇḍalo mānasottaraṃ tasmiṃśca ratnagirau pūrvadakṣiṇāparottareṣu diṅnāgeṣu indrayamavaruṇasomanagarāṇyamarāvatī saṃyamanī su(khā ? ṣā) vibhāvarīti parvatadvīpānāmassyutsavaḥ pāre svādupāriparimaṇḍalo bhūtikamaghabhṛtaḥ
analyzed: gomedadvīpe sura kumudau añjana śātakumbhayoḥ mayau pūrva paścimaḥ varṣaparvataḥ varṣe ca dve varṣaparvata parimaṇḍalaḥ mānasottaram tasmin ca ratna girau pūrva dakṣiṇa apara uttareṣu diś nāgeṣu indra yama varuṇa soma nagarāṇi amarāvatī saṃyamanī sukhā ṣā vibhāvarī iti parvata dvīpānām assi utsavaḥ pāre svādupāri parimaṇḍalaḥ bhūtika maghabhṛtaḥ

original: sālokanirāloko lokāloka ityayutavistārośchrāyaścakravāḷagiriḥ(?) | adhaśca pra....l̤aṃ nāma kṛṣṇabhe.....ṃannamucimagā nāradaśarabhaśaṅkukarṇakabandhakiṣkindhādibhīmaladattaśvāpadādīnāṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ kālayakalaśajayādīnāṃ ca nāgarājānāṃ bhūtimadbhiḥ parassahasrairadhvā.....ṭīyamatalaṃ nāma
analyzed: sāloka nirālokaḥ lokālokaḥ iti ayuta vistāroḥ chrāyaḥ cakravāḷa giriḥ adhas ca pral̤am nāma nārada śarabha śaṅku karṇa kabandha kiṣkindha ādi bhīmaladatta śvāpada ādīnām dānava indrāṇām kālaya kalaśajaya ādīnām ca nāga rājānām bhūtimadbhiḥ parassahasraiḥ adhvāṭīyamatalam nāma

original: pāṇḍubhaumajambhamahājāmbha......śagrīvasuvaśakhajagomukhapramukhāṇāmasurendrāṇāṃ nīlameghakrathanānāṃ ca rakṣodhipānāṃ takṣakāsvaṃtarakaṃ prabalaprabhṛtīnāṃ.....ṃīśvarāṇāṃ śrīmadbhiḥ śobhate purībhiḥ |
analyzed: pāṇḍu bhaumajambha mahājāmbha śagrīva suvaśa khaja gomukha pramukhāṇām asura indrāṇām nīla megha krathanānām ca rakṣaḥ dhipānām takṣakāsvaṃtarakam prabala prabhṛtīnām īśvarāṇām śrīmadbhiḥ śobhate purībhiḥ

original: tṛtīyaṃ tritalaṃ nāma rakta(vṛ ? mṛ)ttikaṃ triśiraḥśiṃśumāratārākṣaprahvādānuhvādā(nni ? gni)mukhādīnāṃ daityendrāṇāṃ cyavanakharavirādhakumbhikolkāmukhānāṃ ca.....ḥāmaṇidattapāṇḍarakapilaviśāviśrāṇāṃ(?) ca darśanaśravasāmṛddhapauravṛndairudyotate |
analyzed: tṛtīyam tritalam nāma raktavṛ mṛttikam agnimukha ādīnām daitya indrāṇām cyavana khara virādha kumbhika ulkāmukhānām ca darśanaśravasām ṛddha paura vṛndaiḥ udyotate

original: caturthaṃ gabhastitalaṃ nāma pītamṛttikaṃ kālanemigajakarṇakuñjarāṇāṃ suradviṣāmeka eva sukumālimuñja.....ṃnāñca naktañcarāṇāṃ caturdaśasahasravihagaviśeṣāṇāṃ bhartuśca kāśyapasya marīci(da ? ta)paḥprabhāvasambhṛtasyendubha......ṇādbhutānubhāvalabdhamahendrasakhyasya yajñamayapuruṣavāhana.....ṃayasya bhagavato vainateyasya vibhāvanīti
analyzed: caturtham gabhastitalam nāma pīta mṛttikam kālanemi gajakarṇa kuñjarāṇām suradviṣām ekaḥ eva naktañcarāṇām caturdaśa sahasra vihaga viśeṣāṇām bhartuḥ ca kāśyapasya marīcida tapaḥ prabhāva sambhṛtasya indu bhaṇa adbhuta anubhāva labdha mahā indra sakhyasya yajña maya puruṣa vāhana aṃayasya bhagavataḥ vainateyasya vibhāvanī iti

original: nagaramudāraśobhamābharaṇāni vedvamadbhiḥ(?) | pamcamaṃ vitalaṃ vāma śaktiriyaṃ virocanādīnāṃ dānavānāṃ mahāmeghadvijihvavidyuṣānāṃ ba....l̤akṛtaḥ sa rājakesarī | mantriṇaśca mahiṣyā saha vindhyaṃ vanaṃ vindhyavāsinīvarivasyāyai gatāstayānayā duṣpravṛttyā tatraiva tanuṃ tyaktavanta iti |
analyzed: nagaram udāra śobham ābharaṇāni pamcamam vitalam śaktiḥ iyam virocana ādīnām dānavānām mahāmegha dvijihva vidyuṣānām bala kṛtaḥ sa rājakesarī mantriṇaḥ ca mahiṣyā saha vindhyam vanam vindhyavāsinī varivasyāyai gatāḥ tayā anayā duṣpravṛttyā tatra eva tanum tyaktavantaḥ iti

original: sā ceyaṃ pratyāvṛttaprāṇasaṃśayā bhūyo′pi tenaivaṃ pratyāśvasyata sādhvī | duravabodhā.....ḍavagatiraprameyāḥ prabhāvamārgāḥ | tathā hi——(rapo ? kaco) nāmāmaragurusutaḥ dasu(?) sampīḍyāsuraiḥ (sarāssannitaḥ ? rahasi nihataḥ) pāṭito′pi bhagavato bhārgaveṇa svodarā(bhe ? de)vodabhāvyata |
analyzed: sā ca iyam pratyāvṛtta prāṇa saṃśayā bhūyas pi tena evam pratyāśvasyata sādhvī duravabodhā āḍava gatiḥ aprameyāḥ prabhāva mārgāḥ tathā kacaḥ nāma amara guru sutaḥ sampīḍya asuraiḥ rahasi nihataḥ pāṭitaḥ api bhagavataḥ bhārgaveṇa sva udara ābhe deva udabhāvyata

original: bhīmābhibhūtabhāradvājapreṣitaiṣīkāstragrastamamadhyottareyasyāḥ(?) pratyāhṛtaṃ dvāri dāmodareṇa | (vṛta ? pitṛ)śāpahataśca nāciketāḥ pretanagarametya pratyājagāma | jāmadagnyaśca rāmaḥ (kapi ? kupita)guruniyogānuvṛttakṛttaśirasaṃ tatprasādāt pratyajīvayat savitrīm | sāvitrī ca pātivratyāt patiṃ patyuḥ pare(tanā ? tānāṃ)hastādācakarṣa(ta?) |
analyzed: bhīma abhibhūta bhāradvāja preṣita aiṣīkā astra grastam a madhya uttare yasyāḥ pratyāhṛtam dvāri dāmodareṇa pitṛ śāpa hataḥ ca nāciketāḥ preta nagaram etya pratyājagāma jāmadagnyaḥ ca rāmaḥ kapi kupita guru niyoga anuvṛtta kṛtta śirasam tad prasādāt pratyajīvayat savitrīm sāvitrī ca pātivratyāt patim patyuḥ tān āṃ hastāt ācakarṣata

original: rāghavaśca śūdraśamiśambukopāyanena lebhe dharmarājā(d) dvijātidārakaṃ, bhīrathyaśca gāndhārarājo nagnabalayomaṃ vijitya prāpto nagnajatvam(?) |
analyzed: rāghavaḥ ca śūdra śami śambuka upāyanena lebhe dharmarājāt dvijāti dārakam bhīrathyaḥ ca gāndhāra rājaḥ vijitya prāptaḥ nagnaja tvam

original: citravibhaktamūrtiḥ.....ṭānāmapi na.....ṃuktā natvabalā sukumārāntarvartī ca bhūtvā samuttīrṇamahārṇavā sarvāvasthāsbapyāyuṣmatāmamṛtyudaśane tvamevāsi pramāṇam, ato′ntareṇa.....ṣatīmṛte samāśvāsahetoḥ yadapi rājño rājahaṃsasya leśato′pyanupalabdhirnāmābhāvarūthaṃ so′pyaprahato maraṇamārgaḥ(?) |
analyzed: citra vibhakta mūrtiḥ ṭānām api sukumāra antarvartī ca bhūtvā samuttīrṇa mahārṇavā sarva avasthāsu api āyuṣmatām amṛtyu daśane tvam eva asi pramāṇam samāśvāsa hetoḥ yat api rājñaḥ rājahaṃsasya leśataḥ upi anupalabdhiḥ nāma abhāva rūtham saḥ upi aprahataḥ maraṇa mārgaḥ

original: tathā ca tasyā devyā......cetarāṇi cānanaṃ puraḥ parā hi sañcarati tadavalambyate dhairyaṃ kvāpi tāpasāśrame tatkālapakṣaṃ karmaphalamaśarapānā nimīlya locane.....ṭaḥ samīpe kāñcidenāṃ kathañcideva jñātīyadvisṛṣṭaḥ(?) sa vidyārthī yathepsitāṃ diśamayāsīt |
analyzed: tathā ca tasyāḥ devyā ca itarāṇi ca ānanam puras parā hi sañcarati tat avalambyate dhairyam kvāpi tāpasa āśrame tad kāla pakṣam karma phalam aśara pānā nimīlya locaneṭaḥ samīpe kāñcid enām kathañcid eva jñātīya dvisṛṣṭaḥ sa vidyārthī yathā īpsitām diśam ayāsīt

original: iyañca jaṭinī valkalinī vrataparā ca jarattapasvinī paricarantī gaṇanāyakaṃ prakṣa.....ṭā kukṣimāśuśukṣaṇeḥ kṣaṇenānena rakṣitaivaṃ deveneti bruvatyaiva sā rajakyarodīt | sa tvidamākarṇya santatāśru śoca(nva?)tīṃ bandhūṃśca niścitya mayā harṣagadga.....ẏonmāṇāmahīsurakucāśca so′timātraṃ sumedhāya kṛpayā vātāvādimāmasti(?) |
analyzed: iyat ca jaṭinī valkalinī vrata parā ca jarat tapasvinī paricarantī gaṇanāyakam prakṣaṭā kukṣim āśuśukṣaṇeḥ kṣaṇena anena rakṣitā evam devena iti bruvatyā eva sā rajakī arodīt sa tu idam ākarṇya santata aśru śocanvatīm bandhūn ca niścitya mayā harṣa gadgaṇa unmāṇā mahīsura kucāḥ ca sumedhāya kṛpayā sumedhāya kṛpayā

original: sa devo rājahaṃsaḥ saha vevyā vasumatyā pitṛbhyośca suśrutasumantrābhyāṃ mātṛbhyāñca(?).....ṇā viśrutamantramuptābhyāmanyaiśca mantridārakaissamaṃ samavardhata |
analyzed: sa devaḥ rājahaṃsaḥ saha vevyā vasumatyā pitṛbhyoḥ ca suśruta sumantrābhyām mātṛbhyām caṇāḥ viśruta mantra muptābhyām anyaiḥ ca mantri dārakaiḥ samam samavardhata

original: upanītaścāpi hi vinīto vidyāsu ṣoḍaśasvṛṣervālmīkisamasya vāmadevasyādeśādvijayaprayāta.....ṇderyāpamānasyānugrahāyāsuraviva(ra)manuktvaivāvatīrṇe deve durava(rā ? bo)dhatayā nirgatapathānāmitastamanviccha......bhita dehānmṛtyumukhapraviṣṭaṃ niṣkrāntayoḥ pitrorvāmapa.....ḍvāgrahīṣameṣa cārthaḥ piturārdrārdrayāntaḥkaraṇapravṛttyā mātuśca me
analyzed: upanītaḥ ca api hi vinītaḥ vidyāsu ṣoḍaśasu ṛṣeḥ vālmīki samasya vāmadevasya ādeśāt vijaya prayāta ṇdeḥ yāpamānasya anugrahāya āsura vivaram an uktvā eva avatīrṇe deve duravarāḥ bodha tayā nirgata pathānām itas tam anvit śabhita dehāt mṛtyu mukha praviṣṭam niṣkrāntayoḥ pitroḥ vāma paḍvā agrahīṣam eṣa ca arthaḥ pituḥ ārdra ārdrayā antaḥkaraṇa pravṛttyā mātuḥ ca me

original: premaprasnutābhyāṃ payodharābhyāṃ pūrvamevāveditaḥ | punaruktaṃ tu mayā kṛtathavādhikamaceṣṭāḥ pralāpāścānantyāntyalakṣaṇā upalakṣayituṃ na śakyāḥ tadalamatiprapañcenāmunā(?) |
analyzed: prema prasnutābhyām payodharābhyām pūrvam eva āveditaḥ punar uktam tu mayā kṛta thavā adhikam aceṣṭāḥ pralāpāḥ ca anantya antya lakṣaṇāḥ upalakṣayitum na śakyāḥ tat alam ati prapañcena amunā

original: vayantu māturāvasathaṃ gatāva.....ḥaratyavāhayāmaḥ parasminna.....ṭasya nidhiṃ janasyopayogamanvaveṃtya saṅgṛhītakatipayapuruṣasteṣāṃ pāpaśodhanāya ṣoḍaśahasta.....ṭānāṃ nagarāṇi nānāra(tna)mayāni dhāra.....ṣarisuvarṇaparvaṇāṃ surārīṇāmutkrośasya niśācarasya śakrasakhasya sarasā nandivardhanasya vāsukervasatimaṇimayabhava.....ṭi |
analyzed: vayantu mātuḥ āvasatham parasmin naṭasya nidhim janasya upayogam anvaveṃtya saṅgṛhīta katipaya puruṣaḥ teṣām pāpa śodhanāya ṣoḍaśa hastaṭānām nagarāṇi nānā ratna mayāni dhāraṣari suvarṇa parvaṇām surārīṇām utkrośasya niśācarasya śakra sakhasya sarasā nandivardhanasya vāsukeḥ vasati maṇi maya bhavaṭi

original: saptamaṃ tu pātāḷanāma hemamayaṃ māyāvāmanatripadinā (na?) dṛṣṭāpadā(ta ? na)syadānavendravṛndārakasya balervairocanasya mucukundasyendranirviśeṣasya ca viṣagharendrasya indranīlāmbarasyendumaṇḍalapāṇḍarasya....l̤asyārcimālino dvisahasrajihvālocanasyā.....ṣsaha svānyeṣāñca nāgarājadanujanātharajanicareśvarāṇāṃ purāṇi pūrṇāni
analyzed: saptamam tu pātāḷa nāma hema mayam māyā vāmana tripadinā na dṛṣṭa āpadāta nasya dānava indra vṛndārakasya baleḥ vairocanasya mucukundasya indra nirviśeṣasya ca viṣa ghara indrasya indranīla ambarasya indu maṇḍala pāṇḍarasya al̤asya arcimālinaḥ sva anyeṣām ca nāga rāja danuja nātha rajanicara īśvarāṇām purāṇi pūrṇāni

original: candramukhīnāmuddharatnadhāmāni nṛttagītanityaramyāṇi dhatte......paryapi (dyo ? jyo)tirmayālokaḥ sarvataśva bahirambuvalayaṃ daśaguṇamavanimaṇḍa......bhūtāni mahānti pūrvaṃpūrvamāvṛtya bhuvanaṃ dhairyamāpādayanti |
analyzed: nṛtta gīta nitya ramyāṇi bahis ambu valayam daśaguṇam avani maṇḍa bhūtāni mahānti pūrvam pūrvam āvṛtya bhuvanam dhairyam āpādayanti

original: paramanādimadhyanidhanamaparimāṇamavyaktaviyati bhuvanakośe yāstā lokapuryodavyagravyagraṃ merorevopari tadāloka(?)......bhavato devabrāhmaṇānugrahādājñāvidheyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
analyzed: param anādi madhya nidhanam aparimāṇam avyakta viyati bhuvanakośe yāḥ tāḥ loka puryoḥ udavyagra vyagram meroḥ eva upari tad āloka bhavataḥ deva brāhmaṇa anugrahāt ājñā vidheyam bhaviṣyati

original: vaiṣṇavānāṃ hi (ceta ? teja)sāmudita iva kaścidaṃśastvadātmanā sthitaḥ, sarva evāto sarvamuni bhraragrahitā bhavantaṃ paribhavadu dvimāsamātraṃ soḍhavyā dvīpasārvadvārikaṃ nakṣatraṃ sarvadigvijigīṣāsaṃvādi śrāvaṇasya tavānukūlavartainaiva prāyāsi pṛthuriva pṛthvīṃ svīkartumityetāvadabhidhāya viramati sma(?) |
analyzed: vaiṣṇavānām hi ceta tejasām uditaḥ iva kaścid aṃśaḥ tvad ātmanā sthitaḥ sarve eva atas sarva muni bhrara grahitāḥ bhavantam dvi māsa mātram soḍhavyāḥ dvīpa sārvadvārikam nakṣatram sarva diś vijigīṣā saṃvādi śrāvaṇasya tava anukūla vartā enā eva prāyāsi pṛthuḥ iva pṛthvīm svīkartum iti etāvat abhidhāya viramati sma

original: sa tathā muniguruprakāśito′tiśakraścakravartīmabhimā sarvalepā......vasanagrahaṇamiva kandharoddharaṇamādāvaṅgeṣvakrāntakarṇaśravaṇatāmakarot, ātmajaprabhāvaśravaṇasumatī kṛtārthamātmānaṃ mene(?) | devo′pi kālavarṣamiva śaṅkaraḥ sarasvatīṃ pratijagrāha |
analyzed: sa tathā muni guru prakāśita uti śakraḥ cakravartīm abhimā sarva lepa avasana grahaṇam iva kandhara uddharaṇam ādau aṅgeṣu akrānta karṇa śravaṇa tām akarot ātmaja prabhāva śravaṇa sumatī kṛtārtham ātmānam mene devaḥ api kāla varṣam iva śaṅkaraḥ sarasvatīm pratijagrāha

original: bhagavāṃśca vāmadevo.....ṣapu......vargyaṃ vinayanibhṛtamanugacchanttaṃ visṛjya rājānaṃ nijaṃ tapovanaṃ jagāma | dampatī cāśramaṃ jagmatuḥ |
